scenes.title: Precise to *4.8 nm*
scenes.caption: double-precision coordinates, even out at GEO

caption:
No scale model. Burnline's Unreal scene is designed at real scale: one unit is one centimetre, so Earth's radius is 637,800,000 units and GEO sits 4.2 billion units out.

That used to be a terrible idea: 32-bit floats only resolve about 2.6 m out at GEO, which is bigger than my whole 1 m accuracy budget. UE5's double-precision coordinates resolve 4.8 nanometres at the same distance.

That's the margin that makes real scale possible.
